messages:
ani: rolling out v2.5.0 -> canary at 5% now. change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. tagging @carla @ricardo for postdeploy checks.
deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: canary rollout initiated · target:5% · variant:v2.5.0 · checks: healthcheck, synth-probe, kv-prefill-scan
carla: kickstarting synth-probe suite (short prompts + long prompts + tokenization smoke). will post failures here.
ricardo: On infra side I'll watch kv-prefill and prefill_cache hit rates. FYI night traffic low but payload size increased slightly due to new embeddings.
ani: note: this rollout includes a tokenizer change, expect small differences in embeddings. Watch for tokenization errors and embedding drift alerts.
carla: synth-probe 1/3 failed: long prompt generator returned 524 on pod canary-2. collecting logs.
ricardo: Ouch. kv-prefill hits dropped on same pod around 02:08 UTC. network retry bursts in the logs.
carla: logs: `error: upstream read timeout at read_exact: connection reset by peer` from canary-2.
deploy-bot: synth-probe update · long_prompt:fail (canary-2) · healthcheck:ok · kv-prefill:degraded
ani: Let's cordon canary-2 from traffic and keep canary weight at 5% (exclude that pod). If other pods are fine continue monitoring for 10m, else rollback.
ricardo: cordon applied: canary-2 marked unschedulable for traffic. rebalancing.
carla: reran synth-probe against remaining canary pods: pass (short+long+tokenize).
ani: Good. keep at 5% for 15m. If no new failures we'll proceed to 25%.
nora: copying release notes to the changelog: "v2.5.0: tokenizer update, embedding size tweak, minor perf improvements". tagging docs team for a brief note on tokenization behavior.
carla: one more note: observed an increase in tail latencies on an internal route `/embed/stream` p99 from 800ms -> 1.1s but only on a single AZ in eu-west-1. not seeing errors, just increased queueing.
ricardo: I patched a kube-proxy restarting pod in that AZ a few minutes ago, tail latencies improved to ~850ms.
ani: OK, target to ramp to 25% in 15m unless telemetry regresses. keep the rollback step handy.
deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: next-check scheduled in 300s
